certification.name: Integrating Risk and Security Certification Credential
certification.description: Credential on integrating risk and security into a TOGAF enterprise architecture, with about three hours of learning. Earned by completing the learning units and passing the assessment bundled with accredited training or self-study; no prerequisites.
certification.currency_note: Assessment is included in an accredited training course or The Open Group self-study pack; no separate voucher is sold
